description: This file defines a custom exception class 'RequestForwardableException' that extends the base Exception class and implements HttpExceptionInterface. It is used within the OrangeHRM HR management system to handle exceptions related to request forwarding, encapsulating details like controller, attributes, query, status code, and headers.

classes.name: RequestForwardableException
classes.description: A custom exception class for request forwarding, carrying additional context such as controller, attributes, query parameters, HTTP status code, and headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a controller, optional attributes, and query parameters.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Returns the name of the controller associated with the exception.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes associated with the request.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes for the request.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code for the exception.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves the headers associated with the exception.
